summary: Updated repo skill parh kar configured v2 production CLI dono Pakistani sites ke liye aik martaba chalaya. Fresh network policy ne dono hosts skip kiye; pipeline starts aur products 0 rahe. Extraction, platform detection, Crawl4AI aur Google mapping nahin chale. Network counters null hain; live browser/merchant verification sabit nahin hui. Yeh explicit file-based app-agent exercise hai, native CLI skill discovery ka proof nahin.
